title: Khmer Republic

endonym.native: សាធារណរដ្ឋខ្មែរ

capsule: The Khmer Republic was proclaimed on 9 October 1970 following the US-backed coup that deposed King Norodom Sihanouk, with General Lon Nol serving as president from 1972. The republic fought a grinding civil war against the Khmer Rouge and North Vietnamese forces, sustained by massive American aerial bombardment of Cambodian territory through 1973. Economic collapse, military incompetence, and US congressional restrictions on further bombing doomed the government; Phnom Penh fell to the Khmer Rouge on 17 April 1975, ending the republic and inaugurating the genocidal Democratic Kampuchea regime.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The republic's territory broadly corresponded to modern Cambodia, but effective government control contracted substantially as the civil war progressed; the contested frontier zones are not precisely mappable.
